levels.name: Starfall
levels.description:
■ Activates at the start of battle as long as the skill user is alive. Affects all allies.
<color=#00AEFF><word_group=10014>Burst Gauge filling speed</word_group> ▲ 3.54% continuously.</color>
■ Activates at the start of battle and when Full Burst ends.
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to squad formation. Only one set of effects is applied.
If there are no other <word_group=10067>standard Burst 1 allies</word_group>:
Effect 1: Affects self. <word_group=10101>Cancels</word_group> Everyone's Star.
Effect 2: Affects self. My Own Star: ATK ▲ 23.64%. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Effect 3: Affects all allies. <word_group=10031>Cooldown</word_group> of Burst Skill ▼ 5.34 sec.
If there are any other <word_group=10067>Burst 1 allies</word_group>:
Effect 1: Affects self. <word_group=10101>Cancels</word_group> My Own Star.
Effect 2: Affects self. Everyone's Star: <word_group=10062>Re-enters Burst and changes to Stage 1</word_group>. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.</color>
■ Activates when landing a Full Charge attack. Affects the target.
<color=#00AEFF>Deals 71% of <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK as additional damage.</color>

lines.text: Having a bunch of people I can count on makes me feel more confident than I expected.
Still not used to me like this, huh? I'm right there with you.
Agh! I'm so bright, it makes my eyes hurt! ... Okay, maybe that's a bit much.
It finally feels like I can stand shoulder to shoulder with you, Commander. That's how brightly you shine.
Now I can confidently state that I'm the star of the Ark. And it's all thanks to you, Commander.
I know there are a lot of stars in the sky, but I hope you see me as the brightest one of them all.
Commander! Where'd you go?! Are you hiding because I was too bright?
Twinkle twinkle, Anis star ♬ Shining brightly for the Ark ♬
Just like the Ark needs a star, the Outpost needs hot water. Hear me? I want a proper hot shower already!
Was this place always this nice and bright? ... Maybe I'm the one who's changed.
Honestly, I really hated it here at first, but now I have so many wonderful memories of this place.
Say hello to the Ark's star! You don't need to fear the dark, because I'll light the way!
I should be able to protect more people now, right?
Now that I've got a reason to become stronger, I'm feeling pretty motivated.
So, what do you think? Better than Rapi and Neon, right? Admit it.
Aww, Commander! You're the best!
Thanks! I'll put this to good use.
Ooh! I think you're getting better at picking out gifts, Commander.
Th-this is kinda embarrassing to say but, uh... I'm really glad I met you, Commander.
How is it that I still get all giddy like this, even after all this time?!
Are you using some kind of new lotion today, Commander? You're glowing!
Okay, leave it to me!
Hm? You called?
I just love those clouds!
All right, everyone, get in line!
Who wants to be first?
Watch closely, Commander!
Don't these things get tired of this?
This is going great!
Phew... Let me catch my breath.
I'm doing pretty good, huh?
Watch me shine!
I will be the star of the Ark!
Enterrr...tainment!
Woohoo!
That was nothing.
Any more?
Ow!
Argh!
Gah...
I'm not giving up, so just hang in there a little longer...!
Did you see me shine out there?
I'm going to become a star for everyone. I'll put on the brightest performance you've ever seen!
When things get tough, look up at the sky. You'll see me there shining for you!
Keep that love for T.T. STAR coming!
I'll always keep the center seat in the front row open just for you. That way, you can be as close as possible while you watch me shine!
I bet you'd be insanely popular if you were a pop star, Commander... I'm glad you didn't go that route.
Look, I don't mind if you cheer for the other girls too, but just... make sure to keep your light stick on yellow, got it?
Commander, I don't have time to be sitting around here! I need to go practice!
Are you hoping for a private performance, Commander? Sorry, it's still in the planning phase...
Heh... This sure brings back memories. We used to perform on streets like this all the time.
I've got an idea! Every morning, I'll sing for you and be your wake-up call. What do you think? Sounds amazing, right?!
We should really look into renovating the shower room. A pop star can't go around looking all dirty, right?
Hi! I'm Anis, and we're the three shining stars, T.T. STAR!
Nice! My body definitely feels lighter... Actually, that might be because I'm on a diet.
Now you're gonna have to come to my next show. It's gonna be perfect!
I've got so many fans, I don't know if I can handle any more!
Ooh, thanks so much! I absolutely love it! That was my best pop star reaction. What do you think?
Thanks! In return, I'm gonna give you an amazing performance!
The gifts you give me definitely feel different from the ones the fans give.
As a pop star, I don't think I'm really supposed to feel this way...
If everything I've gone through was all so I could meet you, Commander, then... well, maybe it wasn't so bad after all.
Agh, what's gotten into me...?! Don't look at me right now, Commander! My face is all red!
Combat star Anis, ready to perform!
You called, Commander?
Yeah, okay.
Did you all come just to see me? You shouldn't have... seriously.
There are haters wherever you go.
You don't deserve to see me perform.
A pop star should always be smiling!
You can see clearly, right?
Time to charge up...!
I'm pretty when I fight, right?
All warmed up!
Time to shine!
Go bright or go home!
Next!
Easy!
Piece of cake!
Ugh...!
Ow!
That hurts!
A pop star... is meant to shine on the battlefield...
I'm Anis from T.T. STAR! Have a good one!
This outfit isn't even even real clothing, y'know. Wanna touch it?
They say stars shine all on their own. Well? Do I look like I'm glowing?
I have so much I want to protect now, but I'm not scared at all. I feel like I can take on anything!
If I run low on light, I'm coming to you for a recharge. Commander... how does it work? Hmm... I'll just squeeze you real tight.
I wanna go beyond the Ark and shine like a star up on the surface, so even if we're far apart, you'll always be able to find me.
Commander, you're like the clouds up on the surface. Just seeing you lifts my mood!
Don't look away, Commander! I know I'm bright, but tough it out and keep your eyes on me!
Stars always shine from the same place, so you can always find your way back. Got it?
Why do we need streetlights? I'm right here... Okay, that sounded better in my head.
They say people used to use the stars to find their way. So if you're lost, just follow me.
The Outpost feels too small to hold someone like me. Let's move somewhere bigger!
Now that I'm a star, I'm gonna shine my brightest!
Anis Starlight, all powered up!
It's still not enough. I want to get even stronger!
Wow, I'm getting way too dazzling for my own good...
As a thank you, I'm gonna flash you a bright Anis smile! Hehe!
I've gotten a lot more used to getting gifts. Thanks, I'll put this to good use.
Hehe, that's my Commander. You've really got my tastes figured out now.
Commander, don't you think it's about time you stopped hitting on me?
Ugh, can Nikkes even get irregular heartbeats...? Why's my heart pounding like this?!
Why do I feel like you're brighter than I am...? Did you turn into the sun or something?
Ready when you are.
Yeah, I'm right here.
Just follow me.
Ugh, everything's so drab.
Keep staring, and you'll go blind!
Ugh, this again?
I'll protect you, Commander.
You watching closely?
Still going strong.
Hang on, I'm going back in!
I've got this!
Outshine the stars, outrun the light!
Light it up!
Way too easy!
Next!
Oh! Did you see that?
Ouch!
Ugh...!
Ngh...!
I can still... shine...!
See? The stars always point you where you're meant to go.
